verdict.rationale: TeamViewer ships AI features, including the Tia AI agent and an AI troubleshooting assistant, so MCP-client support is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or use external MCP servers. The Web API and AI assistant mentions are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
